item.title: California avalanche: How snow drought helped set stage for deadly incident
item.description: Experts say a "snow drought" in Northern California's Sierra Nevada helped set the stage for Tuesday's deadly avalanche.

item.title: How brain exercises can help lower the risk of dementia
item.description: A study in the Alzheimer's Association research journal found that simple brain speed exercises were linked to lowering the risk of dementia by 26% at a 20-year follow-up.

item.title: Low-level snow lures visitors to Oakhurst as Highway 41 closes north of town
item.description: Low-level snow is drawing crowds to the foothill communities. Dozens were able to enjoy the winter weather, for only a fraction of the usual travel time. But Thursday's flurries quickly created dangerous driving conditions further north.

item.title: Fresno city leaders push for deal as Blue Shield, Community Health contract dispute continues
item.description: The impasse between Blue Shield and Fresno's Community Health System continues to drag on. For nearly three weeks, 12,000 enrollees have been unable to get in-network coverage.

item.title: Trump says he doesn't know if aliens are real but directs government to release files on UFOs, more
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday that he's directing the Pentagon and other government agencies to identify and release files related to extraterrestrials and UFOs because of "tremendous interest."

item.title: Orosi man sentenced to life for sexually assaulting multiple children
item.description: The Tulare County Superior Court on Tuesday sentenced 70-year-old Manuel Huitron to life in prison on child molestation charges.
